teaser: A ledger closed before midnight. A deadline moved up by a week, without anyone's permission. You are a 4, and an ENTJ, and the two of them rarely disagree about whether something needs to be built — only about how fast it should go up. The 4 wants the foundation poured right, every beam checked twice. The Commander in you wants the building standing by Friday. What is particular to this crossing is the speed at which solid things get made, and how often the solidity gets mistaken, by other people, for the speed.
excerpt: A toolbox left open on the kitchen counter, labeled dividers inside, nothing out of place — that is roughly how both the number and the type tend to say I love you.
